research_role: paper-linked FinGPT multi-task financial sentiment transfer; not a replication of the original benchmark and not interchangeable with an Ollama Qwen checkpoint

frozen_input_contract.contract_text: Treat every nonempty line in a daily information set as one metadata-prefixed headline. Remove the leading metadata bracket. For each title, use the official FinGPT Benchmark prompt: Instruction: What is the sentiment of this news? Please choose an answer from {negative/neutral/positive}. Input: <headline>. Answer:. Generate greedily with at most 8 new tokens and parse exactly one label from negative, neutral or positive. Daily score equals (positive count minus negative count) divided by parsed headline count. Any unparseable or multiple-label answer makes the information set an explicit error. Market outcomes are not used.

stage0_feasibility_gate.sample: the first 12 causally available headlines in the frozen corpus
stage0_feasibility_gate.failure_action: record infeasibility and stop before Stage 1

stage1_operational_gate_if_stage0_passes.sample: 12 deterministic stratified calendar days per year, 2017-2025
stage1_operational_gate_if_stage0_passes.failure_action: stop before full inference, calibration or backtest

stage2_predictive_gate_if_stage1_passes.allowed_work: one full inference followed by calibration only
stage2_predictive_gate_if_stage1_passes.endpoint: BTCUSDT forward 24-hour return using the existing causal target builder
primary_tests: Pearson correlation between continuous daily sentiment score and forward return
top-tercile minus bottom-tercile mean forward return
stage2_predictive_gate_if_stage1_passes.pass_rule: the lower bound of both predeclared confidence intervals must be greater than zero
stage2_predictive_gate_if_stage1_passes.failure_action: stop before trading threshold selection or backtest

anti_shopping_rule: The candidate pair and revisions are selected by official FinGPT support and hardware feasibility, never by project trading return. All failures remain recorded.
